"""Publish only the complete prerequisite and predecessor acceptance guide."""
import argparse
import gzip
import json
from html.parser import HTMLParser
from pathlib import Path
from common import BASE, OWNER, REVISION, need, pin, save
from intake import git

CHAPTER=Path('docs/book/src/13k-isf-feature-support-matrix.md')
REGISTRY=Path('doctrine/live_document_size/surfaces.jsonl')
ANCHOR='visual acceptance. Complete raw-stack joining remains next.\n\n'
ADDITION='''The raw-stack prerequisite reader now qualifies the unchanged broader observer
and class/frame contracts together. Every completed child retains its original
acceptance. Complete primary, source, parser, public framework, observer, header,
coordinate and address readers execute in their declared source or dated role.
The source class, guard, first cause and each ordered throw phase join every
complete source function, argument and original full header role.

For example, a borrowed whole frame can preserve plausible call syntax while
belonging to another caller. The source/phase/header association rejects it.
Missing children, narrowed acceptance, changed first causes, wrong argument
roles and native-class promotion also reject. The separate full-header lexical
reader supplies quoting and truncation controls; these checks share qualified
source models and do not claim a universal or native identity oracle.

A prerequisite census also found an earlier coordinate draft archive required
by its committed catalog but absent from Git. Its exact whole bytes and every
named member now retain in Git after catalog authentication. Missing or changed
archive bytes reject. The original failed intake and diagnosis remain available.

Replay this complete dated prerequisite qualification:

```bash
scripts/run_with_ram_guard.sh -- python3 -B docs/audits/raw-stack-prerequisites-20261011/verify.py
```

Only the finite observer and class/frame predecessor containers close here.
The complete raw-stack semantic join and its publication remain separately
owned. Original native class, provider, hooks, settings, flags, encoding,
private meanings and referent identities remain unmeasured. Cause, consumer,
alias, cold, permanent, host-native and visual qualification remain open;
HIAL and full CI/push gates retain their own prerequisites.

'''


def aggregate(rows):
    return dict(files=len(rows),lines_total=sum(raw.count(b'\n') for raw in rows.values()),
                bytes_total=sum(map(len,rows.values())))


def source():
    names=[name for name in git('ls-tree','-r','--name-only',REVISION,'--','docs/book/src').decode().splitlines()
           if Path(name).parent==Path('docs/book/src') and name.endswith('.md')]
    before={name:git('show',REVISION+':'+name) for name in names};after=dict(before)
    text=before[str(CHAPTER)].decode();need(text.count(ANCHOR)==1 and ADDITION not in text,'unique original prerequisite book seam')
    after[str(CHAPTER)]=text.replace(ANCHOR,ANCHOR+ADDITION,1).encode()
    return before,after


def authority(before,after):
    a,b=aggregate(before),aggregate(after)
    return dict(authority_id='RAW-STACK-PREREQUISITES-20261011',owner=OWNER,baseline=a,
                delta={key:b[key]-a[key] for key in a},
                rationale='Document complete unchanged observer/class-frame predecessor and raw prerequisite acceptance, exact required archive recovery and genuine controls; complete raw semantics and original native/private identities remain open.')


def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__);parser.add_argument('--publish',action='store_true');parser.add_argument('--native',action='store_true');args=parser.parse_args()
    before,after=source();current={str(path):path.read_bytes() for path in Path('docs/book/src').glob('*.md')}
    if args.publish:
        need(current==before,'sole owned prerequisite guide mutation')
        CHAPTER.write_bytes(after[str(CHAPTER)])
        rows=[json.loads(line) for line in REGISTRY.read_bytes().splitlines()]
        selected=next(row for row in rows if row.get('surface_id')=='shipped_behavior')
        selected['reference_contract']['aggregate_change']=authority(before,after)
        REGISTRY.write_text(''.join(json.dumps(row,sort_keys=True)+'\n' for row in rows))
        save('book-publication.json',dict(revision=REVISION,before={k:pin(v) for k,v in before.items()},
             after={k:pin(v) for k,v in after.items()},authority=authority(before,after),addition=ADDITION))
        print('PASS sole whole prerequisite book addition and exact fresh aggregate authority; ceilings unchanged.')
    else:
        need(current==after,'complete prerequisite book and unchanged source peers')
        if args.native:
            class Text(HTMLParser):
                def __init__(self):super().__init__();self.parts=[]
                def handle_data(self,value):self.parts.append(value)
            raw=Path('docs/book/book/13k-isf-feature-support-matrix.html').read_bytes();reader=Text();reader.feed(raw.decode())
            rendered=' '.join(line for line in ADDITION.splitlines() if not line.startswith('```'))
            need(' '.join(''.join(reader.parts).split()).count(' '.join(rendered.split()))==1,'whole unique rendered prerequisite guide')
            need(not (BASE/'book-native.html.gz').exists(),'retain complete first prerequisite native guide')
            (BASE/'book-native.html.gz').write_bytes(gzip.compress(raw,mtime=0))
            save('book-native.json',dict(chapter=pin(raw),addition=pin(ADDITION.encode()),scope='Whole native guidance and source custody; visual QA remains open.'))
        print('PASS complete whole prerequisite book/source/native guide; visual QA remains separately owned.')


if __name__=='__main__':main()

"""Complete external gate receipts; expected diagnostics remain visible."""
import json
import fcntl
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from common import BASE, canonical, need, pin


if __name__ == '__main__':
    need(len(sys.argv)>=3, 'named check and explicit command')
    name,command=sys.argv[1],sys.argv[2:]
    path=BASE/'checks.json'
    lock_path=Path('.artifacts/raw-stack-prerequisites-20261011/checks.lock')
    lock_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    with lock_path.open('a+b') as lock:
        fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX)
        saved=json.loads(path.read_bytes()) if path.exists() else {}
        need(name not in saved, 'retain first complete check result')
    inputs={str(p):pin(p.read_bytes()) for p in sorted(BASE.glob('*.py'))}
    inputs.update({arg:pin(Path(arg).read_bytes()) for arg in command if Path(arg).is_file()})
    indirect = [Path(name) for name in (
        'scripts/check_record_value_publication.py',
        'scripts/record_value_observer_fact.py',
        'scripts/record_value_observer_namespace_fact.py',
        't/python/test_record_value_current_publication.py',
        'docs/knowledge/record-value-original-observer-helper-paths.md',
        'docs/book/src/13k-isf-feature-support-matrix.md')]
    inputs.update({str(path):pin(path.read_bytes()) for path in indirect})
    result=subprocess.run(command,capture_output=True,text=True)
    after={path:pin(Path(path).read_bytes()) for path in inputs}
    need(after==inputs,'complete direct and declared indirect source epoch conserved')
    # Commands may run independently; only this short read/merge/write is
    # serialized. Reload after the child so an older invocation cannot erase
    # a receipt completed while it was running.
    with lock_path.open('a+b') as lock:
        fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX)
        saved=json.loads(path.read_bytes()) if path.exists() else {}
        need(name not in saved, 'retain first complete check result')
        saved[name]=dict(command=command,status=result.returncode,stdout=result.stdout,stderr=result.stderr,inputs=inputs)
        path.write_bytes(canonical(saved))
    print(name,result.returncode,result.stdout[-1400:],result.stderr[-1800:],flush=True)
    need(type(result.returncode) is int and result.returncode==0,'external check success: '+name)

"""Bind the complete fixed prerequisite domain before semantic reexecution."""
import hashlib
import json
import os
import stat
import subprocess
import tarfile
from pathlib import Path
from common import BASE, CLASS, OBSERVER, RAW, REVISION, SCOPE, canonical, need, pin, save

RECOVERY='docs/audits/coordinate-public-route-checks-20261008/drafts.tar.gz'


def recovery(path=Path(RECOVERY)):
    """Recover a required ignored payload against its already committed catalog."""
    catalog_raw=git('show',REVISION+':'+str(Path(RECOVERY).with_suffix('').with_suffix('.json')))
    catalog=json.loads(catalog_raw)
    actual=regular(path,'100644').read_bytes()
    need(pin(actual)==catalog['archive'],'complete recovered archive fixed-catalog byte identity')
    with tarfile.open(path) as archive:
        members=archive.getmembers()
        names=[member.name for member in members]
        need(len(names)==len(set(names)) and set(names)==set(catalog['members'])
             and all(member.isfile() for member in members),'complete recovered archive regular member graph')
        wanted={member.name:pin(archive.extractfile(member).read()) for member in members}
    need(wanted==catalog['members'],'complete recovered archive member byte identity')
    return dict(catalog=pin(catalog_raw),archive=pin(actual),members=wanted,
                provenance='Previously ignored payload; exact committed e428 catalog authenticates recovery. Not a Git blob at that checkpoint.')


def git(*arguments):
    actual=subprocess.run(['git','--no-replace-objects',*arguments],capture_output=True)
    need(type(actual.returncode) is int and actual.returncode==0 and actual.stderr==b'','complete fixed raw prerequisite Git protocol')
    return actual.stdout


def roots():
    directory=Path('docs/audits')
    raw=json.loads(git('show',REVISION+':'+str(directory/'record-value-original-raw-20261005/binding.json')))
    classes=json.loads(git('show',REVISION+':'+str(directory/'record-value-class-frame-join-20261006/binding.json')))
    address=json.loads(git('show',REVISION+':'+str(directory/'address-raw-admission-20261010/admission.json')))
    selected=set(raw['archives'])|set(classes['inputs'])|set(address['custody']['roots'])
    names=git('ls-tree','-d','--name-only',REVISION+':docs/audits').decode().splitlines()
    families=('observer-','coordinate-','record-value-coordinate-','address-')
    selected.update(str(directory/name) for name in names if name.startswith(families))
    selected.update(str(directory/name) for name in ('record-value-original-raw-20261005',
        'record-value-class-frame-join-20261006','record-value-class-frame-publication-20261006'))
    selected.update(['scripts/check_record_value_publication.py','scripts/record_value_observer_fact.py',
        'scripts/record_value_observer_namespace_fact.py','scripts/record_value_address_fact.py',
        'scripts/record_value_coordinate_fact.py','t/python/test_record_value_current_publication.py'])
    return sorted(path for path in selected if not any(path.startswith(other+'/') for other in selected if path!=other))


def regular(path,mode):
    root=Path.cwd().resolve();full=root/path
    need(not path.is_absolute() and not {'..','.git'}.intersection(path.parts),'own relative raw prerequisite path')
    need(full.resolve()==full and stat.S_ISREG(full.lstat().st_mode) and full.stat().st_dev==root.stat().st_dev,
         'ordinary same-volume raw prerequisite input')
    for parent in full.parents:
        if parent==root:break
        need(not (parent/'.git').exists(),'raw prerequisite repository boundary')
    need(bool(full.stat().st_mode&0o111)==(mode=='100755'),'complete raw prerequisite executable mode')
    return full


def derive():
    selected=roots();raw=git('--literal-pathspecs','ls-tree','-r','-z',REVISION,'--',*selected)
    entries={}
    for record in raw.rstrip(b'\0').split(b'\0'):
        head,name=record.split(b'\t',1);mode,kind,oid=head.decode().split();path=name.decode()
        need(mode in ('100644','100755') and kind=='blob' and path not in entries,'complete regular raw prerequisite member population')
        entries[path]=dict(mode=mode,oid=oid)
    process=subprocess.Popen(['git','--no-replace-objects','cat-file','--batch'],stdin=subprocess.PIPE,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    ledger={}
    try:
        for name,entry in sorted(entries.items()):
            path=regular(Path(name),entry['mode']);before=path.stat()
            process.stdin.write(entry['oid'].encode()+b'\n');process.stdin.flush()
            oid,kind,size=process.stdout.readline().split()
            need(oid.decode()==entry['oid'] and kind==b'blob' and int(size)==before.st_size,'whole fixed/current raw prerequisite object')
            remaining=int(size);digest=hashlib.sha256()
            with path.open('rb') as stream:
                while remaining:
                    chunk=process.stdout.read(min(1048576,remaining))
                    need(bool(chunk) and stream.read(len(chunk))==chunk,'whole fixed/current raw prerequisite bytes')
                    digest.update(chunk);remaining-=len(chunk)
                need(stream.read(1)==b'' and process.stdout.read(1)==b'\n','complete raw prerequisite object boundary')
            after=path.stat()
            need((before.st_dev,before.st_ino,before.st_size,before.st_mtime_ns)==
                 (after.st_dev,after.st_ino,after.st_size,after.st_mtime_ns),'complete raw prerequisite source epoch conserved')
            ledger[name]=dict(**entry,bytes=int(size),sha256=digest.hexdigest())
        process.stdin.close();error=process.stderr.read();status=process.wait()
        need(type(status) is int and status==0 and error==b'' and process.stdout.read(1)==b'','complete raw prerequisite binary Git stream')
    finally:
        if process.poll() is None:process.kill();process.wait()
    observed=set()
    for selected_path in selected:
        path=Path(selected_path)
        if path.is_file():observed.add(str(path));continue
        for directory,children,files in os.walk(path,followlinks=False):
            base=Path(directory)
            for child in children:
                candidate=base/child
                need(not candidate.is_symlink() and not (candidate/'.git').exists(),'own raw prerequisite directory graph')
            observed.update(str(base/name) for name in files)
    need(observed==set(entries)|{RECOVERY},'complete current and fixed raw prerequisite member graph plus exact owned recovery')
    recovered=recovery()
    return dict(revision=REVISION,roots=selected,members=ledger,recovery={RECOVERY:recovered},
                task=pin(git('show',REVISION+':docs/tasks/SEMANTIC-INTROSPECTION-MCP-FRONTIER.md')),scope=SCOPE)


if __name__=='__main__':
    save('intake.json',derive())
    print('PASS complete fixed/current raw prerequisite source/native/product graph and binary byte custody before semantic joining.')

"""Join full class/phase authority to every complete observer header role."""
import copy
import json
import re
from pathlib import Path
from common import BASE, CLASS, OBSERVER, RAW, REVISION, SCOPE, canonical, load, need, pin, save
from intake import git

AUDITS=Path('docs/audits')
TASK=Path('docs/tasks/SEMANTIC-INTROSPECTION-MCP-FRONTIER.md')


def read(name):return json.loads((AUDITS/name).read_bytes())


def blocks(text):
    matches=list(re.finditer(r'^- ID: `([^`]+)`\n.*?(?=^- ID: |\Z)',text,re.M|re.S))
    result={m[1]:m[0] for m in matches}
    need(len(result)==len(matches),'unique complete original predecessor task identities')
    return result


def fields(body):
    return {key:re.search(r'^  '+key+r': `(.*)`$',body,re.M)[1]
            for key in ('Goal','Acceptance','Children') if re.search(r'^  '+key+':',body,re.M)}


def contracts():
    fixed=git('show',REVISION+':'+str(TASK));nodes=blocks(fixed.decode());pending=[CLASS];forest={}
    while pending:
        key=pending.pop();need(key not in forest,'acyclic full predecessor forest')
        forest[key]=nodes[key]
        pending.extend(re.findall(r'SEMANTIC-INTROSPECTION-MCP-FRONTIER[.0-9]*',fields(nodes[key]).get('Children','')))
    need(all('  Status: `done`\n' in body for key,body in forest.items() if key not in (CLASS,OBSERVER)),
         'every original observer/class-frame child completed before predecessor closure')
    return dict(revision=REVISION,task=pin(fixed),forest=forest,
                raw_containers={key:nodes[key] for key in (RAW,RAW+'.5')},scope=SCOPE)


def qualify_contracts(candidate,current):
    expected=contracts()
    need(canonical(candidate)==canonical(expected),'whole unchanged original predecessor/raw acceptance and child contracts')
    nodes=blocks(current)
    for key,body in expected['forest'].items():
        need(fields(nodes[key])==fields(body),'complete live predecessor goal acceptance and children conserve')
        status=re.search(r'^  Status: `(.*)`$',nodes[key],re.M)[1]
        need(status=='done' if key not in (CLASS,OBSERVER) else status in ('active','done'),
             'every complete predecessor child remains done')
    for key,body in expected['raw_containers'].items():
        wanted=fields(body);actual=fields(nodes[key])
        if key==RAW+'.5':
            # This slice owns the explicit three-stage decomposition, which
            # changes no original goal or acceptance requirement.
            actual.pop('Children',None)
        need(actual==wanted,'whole unchanged raw-container original goal and acceptance')


def inputs():
    return (read('record-value-class-frame-join-20261006/source-models.json'),
            read('record-value-class-frame-join-20261006/proofs.json'),
            read('record-value-class-frame-join-20261006/raw-product.json')['inventories'],
            read('observer-original-header-join-20261011/joined.json'),
            read('observer-source-headers-20261011/headers.json'))


def derive(source,qualified,native,headers,expressions):
    records={(mode['mode'],domain,row['index']):row for mode in native
             for domain,values in mode['domains'].items() for row in values['nonempty']}
    cases={(mode['mode'],case['domain'],case['index']):case for mode in source['modes'] for case in mode['cases']}
    joined={(mode['mode'],case['domain'],case['index']):case for mode in qualified['modes'] for case in mode['cases']}
    need(set(records)==set(cases)==set(joined),'complete source/class/frame/original refusal member population')
    declared={tuple(row['allocation']['source_path']):row for row in headers['source_headers']}
    need(len(declared)==len(headers['source_headers']),'unique complete observer source/header role allocation')
    expected_paths=set();result=[]
    for mi,mode in enumerate(source['modes']):
        for ci,case in enumerate(mode['cases']):
            key=mode['mode'],case['domain'],case['index'];record=records[key];proof=joined[key]
            need(proof['exception']==case['exception'],'whole source-inferred exception class and first-cause membership')
            need(record['body'].startswith(case['exception']['primary']+'\n'),'exact complete source first cause before full raw body')
            need(type(record['body']) is str and pin(record['body'].encode())==record['body_identity']==proof['original_whole_body']
                 and ''.join(s['raw'] for s in record['segments'])==record['body'],'whole reversible original class/header raw body')
            frames=[s for s in record['segments'] if s['kind']=='frame'];phases=[]
            need(len(case['phases'])==len(proof['phases']),'complete source and qualified throw-phase population')
            for pi,phase in enumerate(case['phases']):
                prior=proof['phases'][pi];positions=prior['complete_own_positions'];base=('modes',mi,'cases',ci,'phases',pi)
                need(type(phase['phase']) is int and phase['phase']==prior['phase']==pi
                     and phase['family']==prior['family'] and phase['guard_source']==prior['guard_source']
                     and phase['inferred_class']==prior['inferred_class']=='unblessed_nonreference_scalar'
                     and prior['native_class']=='not measured; qualified source/publisher inference only',
                     'whole ordered source guard/family/class phase without native promotion')
                allocations=[]
                for role in ('core','helper','body','entry'):
                    need(len(phase['own'][role])==len(positions[role+'_positions']),'whole own frame role population')
                    allocations.extend((base+('own',role,fi),frame,positions[role+'_positions'][fi])
                                       for fi,frame in enumerate(phase['own'][role]))
                for oi,operation in enumerate(phase['own']['operations']):
                    need(len(operation['frames'])==len(positions['operations'][oi]),'whole operation frame role population')
                    allocations.extend((base+('own','operations',oi,'frames',fi),frame,positions['operations'][oi][fi])
                                       for fi,frame in enumerate(operation['frames']))
                for role in ('body','entry'):
                    allocations.extend((base+('public',role,fi),frame,positions[role+'_positions'][fi])
                                       for fi,frame in enumerate(phase['public'][role]))
                for oi,operation in enumerate(phase['public']['own_eval_boundaries']):
                    allocations.extend((base+('public','own_eval_boundaries',oi,fi),frame,positions['operations'][oi][fi])
                                       for fi,frame in enumerate(operation))
                roles=[]
                for path,frame,position in allocations:
                    expected_paths.add(path)
                    need(path in declared,'every complete own/public source role has a full header')
                    actual=declared[path];allocation=actual['allocation'];header=actual['source_header']
                    need(allocation['record']==list(key) and type(allocation['phase']) is int and allocation['phase']==pi
                         and type(allocation['frame_position']) is int and allocation['frame_position']==position,
                         'exact complete source caller phase and frame allocation')
                    need(actual['original_frame']==frames[position],'whole original header frame belongs to its caller')
                    need(header['expression']['function']==frame['function']==actual['joined']['function'],
                         'complete source function and original full header role')
                    arguments=[expressions['operands'][identifier]['source']['input'] for identifier in header['source_argument_ids']]
                    need(arguments==frame['arguments'],'whole source argument membership order and role')
                    if frame['function']!='eval {...}':
                        need(actual['joined']['complete_call']==frames[position]['call'],
                             'whole original encoded header without prefix normalization')
                    roles.append(dict(source_path=list(path),frame_position=position,function=frame['function'],
                                      source_arguments=arguments,whole_frame=pin(canonical(actual['original_frame'])),
                                      complete_header=pin(canonical(actual))))
                phases.append(dict(phase=pi,family=phase['family'],inferred_class=phase['inferred_class'],
                                   guard=phase['guard_source'],roles=roles))
            need(case['exception']['source_family']==case['phases'][-1]['family'],
                 'final source first cause belongs to final own throw phase')
            result.append(dict(record=list(key),exception=case['exception'],whole_body=record['body_identity'],
                               phases=phases,whole_forwarding=proof['forwarded']))
    need(expected_paths==set(declared),'complete observer header role population without borrowed extra roles')
    need(headers['full_original_raw_domain']==pin(canonical(native)),
         'entire original raw domain remains source-bound')
    need(headers['original_unknowns']==expressions['original_unmeasured'],
         'every original typed observer/native/settings/private uncertainty remains')
    return dict(scope=SCOPE,rows=result,all_original_headers=pin(canonical(headers)),
                unknowns=headers['original_unknowns'],entire_raw_domain=pin(canonical(native)),
                public_load_and_opaque= {key:pin(canonical(headers[key])) for key in ('public_headers','loads','complete_opaque_allocation')},
                independence='Cross-product source/class/phase/role association oracle shares qualified source models and raw catalog with earlier readers. Complete quoting/truncation falsification is the separate original-header lexical reader; no universal language or native identity oracle is asserted.')


def controls(original,product):
    results=[]
    def reject(name,mutate,cause):
        candidate=copy.deepcopy(original);mutate(candidate)
        need(canonical(candidate)!=canonical(original),'genuine complete predecessor intervention')
        try:derive(*candidate)
        except ValueError as error:
            need(str(error)==cause,'intended predecessor association refusal: '+name+': '+str(error))
            results.append(dict(name=name,candidate=pin(canonical(candidate)),status=1,cause=cause))
        else:raise ValueError('false-green predecessor association: '+name)
    reject('missing-source-case',lambda x:x[0]['modes'][0]['cases'].pop(),'complete source/class/frame/original refusal member population')
    reject('native-class-promotion',lambda x:x[0]['modes'][0]['cases'][0]['phases'][0].update(inferred_class='native_blessed'),
           'whole ordered source guard/family/class phase without native promotion')
    reject('first-cause',lambda x:x[2][0]['domains']['api']['nonempty'][0].update(body='Unrelated first cause\n'+x[2][0]['domains']['api']['nonempty'][0]['body']),
           'exact complete source first cause before full raw body')
    reject('wrong-caller',lambda x:x[3]['source_headers'][0]['allocation'].update(frame_position=-1),
           'exact complete source caller phase and frame allocation')
    reject('borrowed-whole-frame',lambda x:x[3]['source_headers'][0].update(original_frame=x[3]['source_headers'][-1]['original_frame']),
           'whole original header frame belongs to its caller')
    reject('missing-full-header',lambda x:x[3]['source_headers'].pop(),
           'every complete own/public source role has a full header')
    reject('wrong-source-argument-role',lambda x:x[0]['modes'][0]['cases'][0]['phases'][0]['own']['core'][0]['arguments'][0].update(role='borrowed_role'),
           'whole source argument membership order and role')
    return results


def main():
    original=inputs();product=derive(*original);task=contracts();qualify_contracts(task,TASK.read_text())
    proof=dict(contracts=task,associations=product,controls=controls(original,product))
    for name,mutate in (
        ('narrowed-observer-acceptance',lambda c:c['forest'].update({OBSERVER:c['forest'][OBSERVER].replace('Derive every wrapper','Derive one wrapper',1)})),
        ('missing-child-contract',lambda c:c['forest'].pop(OBSERVER+'.1'))):
        candidate=copy.deepcopy(task);mutate(candidate);need(candidate!=task,'genuine full task intervention')
        try:qualify_contracts(candidate,TASK.read_text())
        except ValueError as error:
            need(str(error)=='whole unchanged original predecessor/raw acceptance and child contracts','intended full task refusal')
            proof['controls'].append(dict(name=name,candidate=pin(canonical(candidate)),status=1,cause=str(error)))
        else:raise ValueError('false-green original predecessor contract')
    if (BASE/'predecessors.json').exists():need(load('predecessors.json')==proof,'entire unchanged complete predecessor acceptance proof')
    else:save('predecessors.json',proof)
    print('PASS complete unchanged observer/class-frame predecessor acceptance and all child contracts; whole source/class/phase/header/argument/raw membership and genuine controls qualify without native promotion.')


if __name__=='__main__':main()

"""Observe real missing/changed required-archive refusals without changing history."""
import json
import subprocess
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

    print('PASS actual complete required-archive positive and missing/changed-tail refusals; original whole archive remains unchanged.')

"""Execute complete qualified readers, keeping historical and source roles explicit."""
import ast
import json
from pathlib import Path
from common import BASE, REVISION, SCOPE, canonical, load, need, pin, save
from run import execute


def read(path):
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_bytes())


def terminal(path):
    tree=ast.parse(Path(path).read_bytes())
    constants={target.id:node.value.value for node in tree.body if isinstance(node,ast.Assign)
               and isinstance(node.value,ast.Constant) and isinstance(node.value.value,str)
               for target in node.targets if isinstance(target,ast.Name)}
    if 'SUCCESS' in constants:return constants['SUCCESS']
    found=[node for node in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(node,ast.Call)
           and isinstance(node.func,ast.Name) and node.func.id=='print' and node.args
           and isinstance(node.args[0],ast.Constant) and isinstance(node.args[0].value,str)
           and node.args[0].value.startswith('PASS ')]
    need(bool(found),'fixed reader terminal source literal')
    return max(found,key=lambda node:node.lineno).args[0].value+'\n'


def specifications():
    fixed=load('intake.json')['members'];result={}
    previous=Path('docs/audits/observer-current-publication-20261011')
    for name,entry in read(previous/'prerequisites.json')['readers'].items():
        path=previous/entry['receipt'];actual=read(path)
        need(str(path) in fixed and type(actual['status']) is int and actual['status']==0
             and actual['stderr']=='','complete fixed qualified observer reader receipt')
        result['observer-'+name]=dict(command=actual['command'],stdout=actual['stdout'],
            match='whole',context=entry['context'],authority=str(path))
    address=Path('docs/audits/address-current-closure-20261010/acceptance.json')
    for name,actual in read(address)['actual_readers'].items():
        command=actual['command']
        need(command[:2]==['scripts/run_with_ram_guard.sh','--'] and type(actual['status']) is int
             and actual['status']==0,'complete fixed qualified address reader receipt')
        result['address-'+name]=dict(command=command[2:],stdout=actual['stdout'],match='whole',
            context='dated publication snapshot' if name=='preparation' else 'complete unchanged source and original finite products',
            authority=str(address),guard='outer raw prerequisite RAM guard supervises every nested process')
    for name,folder in (
        ('primary','record-value-original-primary-20261005'),
        ('raw-inventory','record-value-original-raw-20261005'),
        ('source-helper','record-value-original-helper-join-20261005'),
        ('source-class','record-value-original-class-20261005'),
        ('source-api','record-value-original-api-paths-20261005'),
        ('class-admission','record-value-class-frame-admission-20261006'),
        ('class-dated-publication','record-value-class-frame-publication-20261006'),
        ('address-dated-closure','address-current-closure-20261010'),
        ('observer-dated-namespace-repair','observer-publication-namespace-repair-20261011'),
        ('recovered-coordinate-drafts','coordinate-public-route-checks-20261008')):
        path=Path('docs/audits')/folder/('pack_drafts.py' if name=='recovered-coordinate-drafts' else 'verify.py')
        need(str(path) in fixed,'fixed additional reader source authority')
        authority=path.with_name('contracts.py') if name=='address-dated-closure' else path
        need(str(authority) in fixed,'fixed additional reader terminal authority')
        result[name]=dict(command=['python3','-B',str(path)],stdout=terminal(authority),match='terminal',
            context='complete dated retained publication evidence; no later currency' if 'dated' in name else 'complete fixed source and original finite products',
            authority=str(authority))
    return result


def qualify(actual,spec):
    need(type(actual['status']) is int and actual['status']==0,'actual integer prerequisite success')
    need(actual['command']==spec['command'],'exact whole prerequisite command')
    need(actual['stderr']=='' and type(actual['stdout']) is str,'complete clean prerequisite streams')
    need((actual['stdout']==spec['stdout'] if spec['match']=='whole' else actual['stdout'].endswith(spec['stdout'])),
         'whole declared prerequisite stdout role')
    need(type(actual.get('programs')) is dict and bool(actual['programs']),'complete recorded prerequisite runner programme epoch')
    for path,programme in actual['programs'].items():
        need(Path(path).parent==BASE and pin(programme['body'].encode())==programme['identity'],
             'whole retained prerequisite runner programme bytes')


def main():
    results={}
    for name,spec in specifications().items():
        existing=sorted(BASE.glob('actual-reader-'+name+'-*.json'))
        if existing:
            path=existing[-1];actual=read(path)
        else:
            actual=execute('reader-'+name,spec['command'])
            path=sorted(BASE.glob('actual-reader-'+name+'-*.json'))[-1]
        qualify(actual,spec)
        results[name]=dict(specification=spec,receipt=str(path),identity=pin(path.read_bytes()))
    product=dict(revision=REVISION,scope=SCOPE,readers=results)
    if (BASE/'readers.json').exists():need(load('readers.json')==product,'whole unchanged fresh prerequisite replay')
    else:save('readers.json',product)
    print('PASS complete fresh primary/source/context/inventory/class/API/public/parser/observer/header/coordinate/address readers with exact actual receipts and explicit dated roles.')


if __name__=='__main__':main()

"""Retain every actual command, stream and complete program epoch, including failures."""
import subprocess
import sys
from common import BASE, canonical, need, pin, save


def execute(label, command):
    previous = list(BASE.glob('actual-' + label + '-*.json'))
    name = 'actual-' + label + '-' + str(len(previous) + 1) + '.json'
    programs = {str(p):dict(identity=pin(p.read_bytes()), body=p.read_text())
                for p in sorted(BASE.iterdir()) if p.suffix in ('.py', '.pl')}
    result = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True)
    record = dict(command=command, status=result.returncode, stdout=result.stdout,
                  stderr=result.stderr, programs=programs)
    save(name, record)
    print(name, result.returncode, result.stdout[-500:], result.stderr[-1000:], flush=True)
    need(type(result.returncode) is int and result.returncode == 0 and not result.stderr,
         'actual complete successful step: ' + name)
    return record


if __name__ == '__main__':
    need(len(sys.argv) >= 3, 'label and explicit command required')
    execute(sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2:])

def members():
    root=Path.cwd().resolve();result={}
    need(BASE.resolve()==root/BASE and not (BASE/'.git').exists(),'own complete raw prerequisite namespace root')
    for path in sorted(BASE.rglob('*')):
        mode=path.lstat().st_mode
        need(stat.S_ISREG(mode) and path.resolve()==root/path and path.stat().st_dev==root.stat().st_dev,
             'complete flat regular raw prerequisite member graph without hidden directories')
        if path.name not in ('manifest.json','checks.json'):
            result[str(path.relative_to(BASE))]=dict(**pin(path.read_bytes()),executable=bool(mode&0o111))
    return result


def actual_readers():
    product=load('readers.json');specs=replay.specifications()
    need(set(product['readers'])==set(specs) and product['revision']==REVISION and product['scope']==SCOPE,
         'complete fresh prerequisite reader population and original scope')
    for name,spec in specs.items():
        entry=product['readers'][name];path=Path(entry['receipt'])
        need(path.parent==BASE and entry['specification']==spec and pin(path.read_bytes())==entry['identity'],
             'complete actual prerequisite receipt and authority')
        replay.qualify(json.loads(path.read_bytes()),spec)
    first=next(iter(specs));entry=product['readers'][first];original=json.loads(Path(entry['receipt']).read_bytes())
    results=[]
    for name,mutate,cause in (
        ('Boolean-status',lambda x:x.update(status=True),'actual integer prerequisite success'),
        ('nonzero-status',lambda x:x.update(status=1),'actual integer prerequisite success'),
        ('borrowed-command',lambda x:x.update(command=['python3','-B','borrowed-reader.py']),'exact whole prerequisite command'),
        ('short-success-stream',lambda x:x.update(stdout='PASS\n'),'whole declared prerequisite stdout role')):
        candidate=copy.deepcopy(original);mutate(candidate);need(candidate!=original,'genuine prerequisite actual-result intervention')
        try:replay.qualify(candidate,specs[first])
        except ValueError as error:
            need(str(error)==cause,'intended actual prerequisite result refusal')
            results.append(dict(name=name,candidate=pin(canonical(candidate)),status=1,cause=cause))
        else:raise ValueError('false-green actual prerequisite result')
    return dict(readers=pin(canonical(product)),actual_result_controls=results)
